title: The First Wine of 2026 Arrives November 19, From the Earliest Harvest on Record
yt_title: Beaujolais Nouveau 2026: Release Date and How to Drink It

slides.label: The rule
slides.text: *Beaujolais Nouveau* can't be sold under that name until the *third Thursday of November*: this year, *Nov 19*.

slides.label: The party
slides.text: Beaujeu's *Sarmentelles* festival runs *Nov 18 to 22* and opens the new wine at *midnight*.

slides.label: The vintage
slides.text: 2026 came from the *earliest harvest on record*. Last year the region sold about *13.8 million* bottles.

slides.label: Serve it
slides.text: Chill to *54 to 57°F*. Twenty minutes in the fridge. Pair it with *charcuterie, roast chicken or pizza*.

slides.label: Trade up
slides.text: Like it? Try a *cru*: *Fleurie, Morgon, Moulin-à-Vent* or *Brouilly*. Same grape, serious wine.

cta_line: The first bottle of the year. *Salud.*
